description: Source code for the RocksDB implementation of KVStore in Apache Spark, including database configuration, serialization, index management, and iterator handling.

classes.name: TypeAliases
classes.description: Holds a mapping of class names to byte array aliases for shorter keys.

classes.name: PrefixCache
classes.description: Caches prefixes for entity keys to optimize index operations.

methods.name: RocksDB
methods.description: Constructor initializing RocksDB instance with file path and serializer.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata object of specified class from the database.

methods.name: setMetadata
methods.description: Stores or deletes metadata in the database.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Fetches a value by key and deserializes it into specified class.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Serializes and stores a value with a given key.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads an object of specified class using a natural key.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Serializes and writes a value to the database.

methods.name: writeAll
methods.description: Batch writes multiple values, grouped by class.

methods.name: updateBatch
methods.description: Updates a batch with index entries for a value.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes an entry by class and natural key.

methods.name: view
methods.description: Returns a view (iterator) over entries of a specific class.

methods.name: removeAllByIndexValues
methods.description: Removes all entries matching index values.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Counts entries of a type, optionally filtered by index value.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the database and associated iterators.

methods.name: closeIterator
methods.description: Closes a specific iterator if the database is open.

methods.name: notifyIteratorClosed
methods.description: Removes iterator from tracking when closed.

methods.name: getTypeInfo
methods.description: Retrieves index and type info for a class.

methods.name: db
methods.description: Returns the current RocksDB instance, throws if closed.

methods.name: getTypeAlias
methods.description: Retrieves or assigns a short alias for a class name.
